en:
Hah-haha! Did you have a good time hangin'
out with me and my great big beautiful tits!?

I had a great time!
It was crazy fun!

You better rack your brain tryin' to figure out
where we'll hang out next!

Well, I'm sure the two of us will have fun
no matter where we go!

Okay...I'm lookin' forward to our next
hangout session...

I gotta admit, I think you actually managed to
entertain me today.

Feel free to use your memories of today
to help ya do what you gotta do!

Hah-hahaha! Man, I'm hungry!
Wanna head back?

That was alright, I guess.
I'm still feelin' frisky, though...

I'm gonna give it to you straight—your
performance was lousy today!

Well, I guess this is the best I could expect
from someone like you!
